data.name: Jibran
data.gender_notes: Jibran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful Islamic name with deep spiritual significance. The name Jibran carries the meaning “Noble and blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jibran usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the Blessing and Faith and Nobility nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Jibran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibran total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
